summary: Backup runs and metadata receipts settle instead of pending forever: unknown policy or repository settles failed, runs of unreachable, non-ready, departed or master-hosted members settle failed with stage peer_dispatch, stale journal entries no longer block new backups, and eject and promote ignore runs owned by unserviceable members. The Back up now panel opens above the lists.

guide.reason: Operators need a new operation ID after a failed unknown-repository request, and an explanation of runs that settle failed at peer_dispatch.

api.reason: Behavior only: backup-now, catalog rebuild and import for an unknown policy or repository settle failed on the first attempt and the operation ID stays failed; runs settle failed at stage peer_dispatch. No fields or endpoints change. docs/API.md needs the note (requested from the API owner).

roadmap.reason: Bug fixes inside the backup recovery plan; no milestone changes.

state.record: The pool master's backup run record and operation receipt (status, stage, error).
state.reason: No new durable state; existing records settle terminally and a fresh Controller reads them through the existing run and operation inventory.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/agent (unit, no lab) and the earlier web source tests. The selection source test was retired by the backup workspace redesign on 2026-10-01; that redesign has separate browser-only evidence and does not extend this record's native settlement coverage.
